verdict: Leads surged and cost dropped — but intake must now convert them.
narrative: This period your Meta campaign delivered 50 leads at $35.33 per lead, a 40% improvement in cost efficiency on nearly the same spend as the prior week — the last three days alone accounted for 17 of those leads, confirming the trend is real and accelerating. The ads side is working. The gap to close now is intake: your CRM shows 43 of those 50 leads recorded and zero have moved into the pipeline, meaning leads are arriving but not being worked. SMS automation and voice access — the tools that would drive contact with those leads — are being brought online to address this directly. Organic visibility through your Google Business Profile dropped sharply this week, which we're monitoring and addressing through a posting cadence going live by end of September. Expect continued lead volume at or below this cost level next week, with the focus shifting toward ensuring every lead received is contacted and tracked.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period from paid search advertising
cost per lead this period, down 40% from the prior week
actions taken on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, clicks, and direction requests

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but none have moved into the pipeline — the CRM shows zero opportunities created from 50 leads received.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation and voice access are being activated now so your team can contact and log inbound leads without manual gaps.
